{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kuat Main Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Orbital Array]] that commissioned completed [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was located in a ring of other installations that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="Coruscant">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
